role: Senior Staff Machine Learning Engineer - Content Platform
company_profile: Spotify is an audio streaming service, and its Content Platform team builds the ML systems that understand, moderate and route music, podcast and audiobook content for listeners and creators.
title: Senior Staff Machine Learning Engineer
summary: Machine learning engineer with 8+ years building production ML and LLM systems for classification, ranking, anomaly detection and automated decisioning across Healthcare, Telecom and AIOps, with an MSc in Machine Learning and AI. Designs systems end to end, from PySpark data pipelines and PyTorch models to rigorous LLM evaluation, tracing and deployment with FastAPI, Docker and MLflow. Works with product and business teams to turn ambiguous problems into reliable systems. Alongside this, I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD.

experience_edits.original: Built an event-correlation engine clustering alarms with Sentence-BERT
experience_edits.new: Designed an event-correlation system clustering alarms with Sentence-BERT and DBSCAN, tracing cascading network alarm floods back to the root event and improving semantic alarm classification by 73.5%.

experience_edits.original: Deployed a production SLA breach prediction system with LightGBM
experience_edits.new: Deployed a production decisioning system predicting SLA breaches with LightGBM, FastAPI and MLflow, with GPT-3.5 giving real-time root-cause analysis and remediation per breach, reducing downtime by 67%.

experience_edits.original: Built automated evaluation and observability pipelines for Question
experience_edits.new: Built automated evaluation and observability for Question Answering and Summary Agents with LLM evaluators, tracing and failure detection, balancing automation with quality and cutting human-in-the-loop review by 43%.

experience_edits.original: Implemented a reranker for an existing recommendation system
experience_edits.new: Implemented a ranking model on top of an existing recommendation system for individual and child plans, improving renewal suggestions and increasing conversion by 2%.

project.name: Content Policy Risk Classifier
bullets: Built a risk-detection system for user-generated podcast transcripts and metadata, fine-tuning a Transformer classifier in PyTorch and routing borderline items to an LLM policy reviewer with explanations.
Evaluated precision and recall per policy category on human-labelled audits with fairness slices, then served the classifier through FastAPI in Docker with MLflow tracking.

paragraphs: I am applying for the Senior Staff Machine Learning Engineer role on the Content Platform team. For eight years I have built ML systems whose outputs drive real decisions, from telecom alarm classification to healthcare agents that replace manual review. What ties that work together is getting automation right without losing quality.

Spotify has to decide, in real time, whether a constant stream of new music, podcasts and user-generated content is safe and correctly understood. That mix of scale, policy and fairness is the problem I want to spend the next years on. My fiancée lives in Berlin, and we plan to move to Stockholm together and settle in Sweden long term.

I would bring systems thinking across models, evaluation and serving. At Viavi I deployed an SLA breach prediction system with LightGBM and GPT-3.5 root-cause analysis that cut downtime by 67%, and built alarm classification with Sentence-BERT and DBSCAN. At United Health Group my evaluation pipelines with LLM evaluators reduced human review by 43%.

Outside work I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD. It keeps me honest about who a system is for: the teacher and the student, not the metric. I would be glad to talk about how I could help your team.
